proposal.title: Convert DRI portable CP/M Platform Extensions to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: DRI portable CP/M Platform Extensions
before.description: Optional, documented CP/M Platform Extensions for non-Logix manufacturers, covering text-mode TUI, capability discovery and FlexiBUS adapters. Ordinary CP/M remains usable without them. Implementations require host-specific integration and qualification; this software offering does not imply delivery of the Aurelia ROM cartridge or an identical binary image to other manufacturers. DRI may adapt and distribute the accepted AION-developed CP/M TUI under the three-party development agreement; each external host requires its own driver integration and qualification.

specification.description: DRI develops and licenses the portable CP/M extensions.
DRI may implement and license the CP/M enhancements for non-Logix computers.
The portable extensions provide CP/M integration for the shared text-mode interface conventions.
The extension scope includes CP/M-side adapters for qualified FlexiBUS hosts.
